title: Omni Condenser Assembly W/ Mouthpiece
description:
The Omni Condenser Assembly is designed to be used with the omni range of Dynavap vaporizers and is entirely made out of titanium. It also includes three high temp o-rings.
The Omni Condenser Assembly is compatible with body length midsection. But is Not compatible with the “M” or stem midesections.
Includes
1 x Standard Omni Condenser Assembly
